gt.title: MEMORANDUM

blocks.text: The operations team will move to Suite 4B on Floor 12 on Aug 17, 2026. Please pack your desk into no more than 3 boxes and label each box with your name and new desk number.
Movers arrive at 8:30 AM. Network and phones will be offline from 6:00 PM the day before until noon on moving day. Lena Hoffmann coordinates the move; send questions to the facilities queue.
The approved moving budget is $18,500. Receipts for personal items are not reimbursed.
1. Pack by 4:00 PM the day before the move.
2. Keep laptops with you; do not pack them.
3. Unpack by Friday so the old floor can be handed back.
